description: The default implementation of RevocationChecker::check_revocation_against_anchor (pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs line 286) always returns Ok(()). While CrlChecker and OcspChecker both override it, there is no integration test that verifies: (a) a custom checker that does NOT override it truly silently skips the check, and (b) that the skip is observable in the chain output. The security doc warns 'Failing to override...is a silent security gap' but no test proves this gap is observable. A test using a stub checker that asserts the anchor-issued cert check is NOT called would document the intentional behavior and prevent future regression.
title: pkix-path check_revocation_against_anchor default implementation not tested in any integration test
